# Snapajoy

> Snapajoy helps customers in India design premium photo books through WhatsApp, review a free video preview, request free edits before approval, and use a web editor for advanced changes.

## Preferred URLs

- Homepage: https://www.snapajoy.com/
- Photo books: https://www.snapajoy.com/photo-books
- How it works: https://www.snapajoy.com/how-it-works
- Pricing: https://www.snapajoy.com/pricing
- Examples: https://www.snapajoy.com/examples
- Stories: https://www.snapajoy.com/reviews
- Web editor: https://www.snapajoy.com/editor
- Help: https://www.snapajoy.com/help
- Shipping: https://www.snapajoy.com/shipping
- Refunds and replacements: https://www.snapajoy.com/refunds
- Privacy: https://www.snapajoy.com/privacy
- Contact: https://www.snapajoy.com/contact

## Product Facts

- Primary product name: photo book.
- Related terms: photo album, family album, WhatsApp photo album, and album-style photo book.
- Formats: 8 x 6 in from Rs 1250, 8 x 8 in from Rs 1650, and 10 x 10 in from Rs 3250.
- Recommended format: 8 x 8 in.
- Binding: hardcover layflat.
- Pages: premium printed pages made to resist everyday spills, fading, and tearing.
- Personalization: personalized cover title.

## Ordering And Editing

- Customers start on WhatsApp.
- The first design is available in under 10 minutes, 24/7.
- Customers receive a free video preview before placing the order.
- Edits are free before approval.
- Customers can use the web editor for advanced changes.
- Printing starts only after approval.

## Delivery, Support And Privacy

- Photo books ship in about 1 week after approval.
- Delivery is available across India within 2 weeks after approval.
- Customers can send feedback anytime on WhatsApp.
- Snapajoy does not use customer photos for marketing without consent.
- Customers can request photo deletion by typing help in the WhatsApp chat.
